name: How long does a typical bathroom renovation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom renovation project depends heavily on its complexity and the scope of work. A small cosmetic update, such as painting and replacing a vanity, might be completed in 1-2 weeks. A mid-sized renovation involving new fixtures, tiling, and some plumbing updates typically takes 3-5 weeks. Larger projects with significant layout changes, custom installations, or structural modifications can extend to 6-8 weeks or even longer. We prioritize efficient scheduling and clear communication to minimize disruption and ensure timely completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom renovation timelines vary; minor updates take 1-2 weeks, mid-sized projects 3-5 weeks, and major remodels 6-8 weeks or more, depending on scope.
